summary: James "Jamie" Garrett, 36, of Vail, missing since last seen in West Vail on Tuesday; found deceased around 1 p.m. Saturday 2011-07-09 on Muddy Pass Road north of Vail (Piney River area) by a Vail Mountain Rescue search team; coroner ruled the manner of death suicide

notes: Article dated 2011-07-11; crews searched the Piney River area on a tip from friends that Garrett might be there; first Eagle-2011 row (zero-row year before this insert)
